description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to the latest supported Java runtime and framework baseline for Azure modernization.
tasks.reason: The project currently targets Java 8 and requires runtime modernization before cloud-native migrations.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade project runtime and framework baseline to the latest compatible version, including build configuration updates needed for Azure-ready modernization.

tasks.description: Modernize database connectivity to Azure SQL with cloud-native authentication.
tasks.reason: Current SQL connectivity relies on direct credentials; cloud-native Azure deployment should use managed identity.
tasks.requirements: Migrate SQL Server connectivity to Azure SQL and use managed identity based authentication for data access in the scheduler workflow.

tasks.description: Move application credentials and secrets to Azure Key Vault.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses environment/plaintext database credentials and should adopt centralized secret management.
tasks.requirements: Replace plaintext/environment credential usage with Azure Key Vault backed secret retrieval for all scheduler database and service secrets.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before Azure deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required for every modernization plan to reduce known dependency risk.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions; document major-version remediation risks and verify project build and tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized ZavaBatchScheduler application to Azure.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested Azure deployment of the modernized application.
tasks.requirements: Containerize as needed and deploy the application to Azure Container Apps using existing or provisioned Azure resources with managed identity based authentication.
